## Problem

Describe the learner-facing or maintainer-facing problem.

## Change

Describe the smallest relevant change and any state-schema or authorization impact.

## Evidence

- [ ] `python scripts/check_package.py`
- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
- [ ] Realistic forward-test scenario when behavior changed

## Safety and privacy

- [ ] No credentials, private learner data, copyrighted course content, or unredacted transcripts
- [ ] Goal approval, project isolation, and normal tool permissions remain intact
- [ ] Third-party material is attributed and license-compatible
